text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I... DID IIIT!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Absolutely spectacular! At long last,<n>the Mejiro
family's dream has been<n>realized at the Derby!
Mejiro Ryan<n>displays the pride of her esteemed
lineage!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Ryan. Everyone<n>watching was
inspired by your<n>performance.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I just couldn't do it. I reallywanted to cross that finish line first...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Argh! This sucks! I'm so frustrated<n>right now...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: My legs won't even listen to me<n>anymore...

text_block_list.name: Ines's Little Sisters
text_block_list.text: Big Sis! You were incredible!

text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text:
That was crazy! She looks totally<n>wiped out! But
still...

text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text: Why does she look so freakin' cool?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I have to... stand up...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...I have to go!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Please... Lend me your shoulder. I<n>want to get
closer...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...There might be a little of this<n>applause that's for
me!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(This was my dream—charging across<n>the Derby
finish line with the crowd's<n>passionate cheers
behind me.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(But I couldn't do it. I gave it<n>everything I had, but
there was still<n>too much I was lacking.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(I don't have any strength left in my<n>legs. I feel
pretty pathetic right now,<n>but even so...)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I want to make a promise... to<n>everyone who
cheered for me.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: WOOOOO! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Big Siiis! You fought hard out there,<n>Ines!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Haha. I can hear it. Their voices are<n>reaching me.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Next time, I'll win for sure. You can<n>count on it.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I'll keep doing whatever it takes!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Great race today, Ines.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Let's compete again at the Kikuka<n>Sho. I know you
won't back down!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
When we get to the waiting room,<n>Ines Fujin smiles
while gently<n>signaling with her hand that she's<n>okay
now.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Did I manage to wave properly at the<n>crowd?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I'm glad to... hear that...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Thud!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Really... glad...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Ines Fujin collapses onto the waiting<n>room floor.
